categories.main_business_segments: Hyosung Advanced Materials Corporation operates primarily in three business segments: Industrial Materials, Fibers, and Others. The Industrial Materials segment includes tire reinforcement materials, industrial yarns, carpets, aramid fibers, and carbon fibers. The Fibers segment focuses on high-value-added, high-functionality fibers such as spandex and polyester yarns mainly for apparel use. The Others segment includes nylon films and leasing businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies for producing tire cords, steel cords, industrial yarns, aramid fibers, and carbon fibers. It employs specialized heat treatment and processing techniques for steel cords and high-performance fiber development. Research and development are conducted through in-house and outsourced facilities focusing on product differentiation, such as high-strength tire cords, carbon fiber prepregs, and eco-friendly materials. Production is continuous process-based with high automation and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global tire manufacturers like Hankook Tire, Kumho Tire, Goodyear, Michelin, and automotive safety component suppliers such as Autoliv and ZF. The company serves the automotive industry extensively, supplying tire reinforcement, seatbelt yarns, airbags, and automotive carpets. Other markets include industrial sectors requiring high-performance fibers and specialty films for packaging and electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: Hyosung Advanced Materials operates globally with production facilities and subsidiaries in South Korea (Ulsan, Jeonju, Daejeon), Vietnam (Dong Nai Province, Quang Nam), China (Qingdao, Jiaxing, Jiangsu), Luxembourg, Germany, and Romania. Sales and exports cover North America, Europe, China, and Southeast Asia, with significant export volumes to the USA and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing and supplying advanced materials and components such as tire cords, industrial yarns, and specialty fibers to downstream automotive and industrial manufacturers. It sources raw materials like PET chips, wire rods, PTMG, MDI, and nylon chips from both affiliated and external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maintaining global market leadership in polyester tire cords and expanding high-value-added new materials like carbon fibers and aramid fibers. R&D focuses on product differentiation, eco-friendly materials, high-strength and high-modulus fibers, and advanced carbon fiber prepregs for hydrogen fuel tanks and aerospace applications. The company invests continuously in capacity expansion and technology upgrades to enhance cost competitiveness and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of industrial materials, fibers, and specialty films. The company sells directly to global tire manufacturers, automotive parts suppliers, and industrial customers via local and export channels. Sales include both domestic and international transactions, with a significant portion derived from exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hyosung Advanced Materials is a global leader in polyester tire cords and industrial yarns, competing with major global chemical fiber and industrial material producers. It holds a top market share in tire reinforcement materials and is recognized for technological leadership in carbon fiber and aramid fiber markets. Competitors include other global fiber and composite material manufacturers serving automotive and industrial sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 3.2 trillion, with industrial materials accounting for about 99% of sales. Operating profit declined to KRW 172 billion due to challenging global economic conditions. Total assets stood at KRW 3 trillion with a debt ratio of 304.5%. The company has shown steady capacity expansion investments, particularly in carbon fiber production, signaling growth focus despite recent profit declines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hyosung Advanced Materials emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced products such as high-strength polyester tire cords, eco-friendly and differentiated industrial yarns, and cutting-edge carbon and aramid fibers. Its global production footprint enables close customer proximity and supply stability. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities and long-term customer partnerships to deliver reliable, innovative materials critical for automotive safety and performance, positioning itself as a trusted partner in high-value industrial materials.
